positive.sql: SELECT (SELECT name FROM person WHERE person.id = pv.person_id) AS person_name, (SELECT name FROM pizzeria WHERE pizzeria.id = pv.pizzeria_id) AS pizzeria_name FROM (SELECT person_id, pizzeria_id FROM person_visits WHERE visit_date >= '2022-01-07' AND visit_date <= '2022-01-09') AS pv ORDER BY person_name, pizzeria_name DESC;
